subject: Vendor onboarding: bank credentials and PO tagging for Lumen Labs
messages:
From: Erin Cho <erin.cho@lumenlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: bank details and PO tags

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist earlier today — excited to get Redwood set up as a vendor. Attached is a bank-letter PDF with our routing/account info and a point of contact. We can accept ACH and wires; ACH is preferred.

Quick notes: 
- Company name: Lumen Labs Inc.
- Remittance narrative we use on our side: "Invoice: <invoice-number>" (please try to preserve the word Invoice)
- Preferred PO tag: LUMEN-<PO#> appended to invoice description so our AP system can auto-match

I attached: lumen_bank_letter.pdf (bank letter) and will send the completed W-9 in a follow-up (we missed the W-9 step initially).

Can you confirm whether we should include the PO tag in the invoice reference or the remittance description? Also let us know if you need anything else for rapid activation (portal invite, EIN confirmation, signed onboarding form).

Thanks,
Erin Cho
Finance Ops | Lumen Labs
M: +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachments: lumen_bank_letter.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Cho <erin.cho@lumenlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank details and PO tags

Hi Erin — thanks for the bank letter, that helps. A few quick asks so we can complete vendor setup on our side:

1) Please attach the completed W-9 (we need it for payment activation).
2) For PO mapping: we prefer the PO tag to appear in the invoice "Description/Reference" field (our AP import maps that to the PO field automatically). If you can put LUMEN-<PO#> in the invoice description, that will be best.
3) Do you have a preferred remit email for payment notifications (e.g., remit@lumenlabs.com)?
4) We'll run a micro-deposit test for ACH to validate the account. If all good, our first scheduled payment will be in the next AP cycle.

Jordan, looping you in for micro-deposit confirmation and to confirm PO mapping on our side. Marissa — FYI on onboarding progress and to track any required forms.

Erin — once we have the W-9 and remit email, I'll kick off the activation.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: (none)

We confirm the remit email is payops@lumenlabs.com. Our AP team will include the PO tag in the invoice description as requested (example: "Consulting services — Invoice: 2026-0814 | LUMEN-98765").

Forwarding our bank letter again for reference.

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank details and PO tags — micro-deposit received

Hi Samir / Erin — quick update from Finance: we completed the micro-deposit test this morning and received the two small amounts back to our test account, so the ACH link is validated.

PO mapping notes for our AP import (so there is no mismatch):
- Please include the PO tag exactly as "LUMEN-<PO#>" in the invoice Description/Reference field.
- The invoice number should still be its native number (we import invoice number separately).
- If invoice PDF includes both Invoice:<number> and LUMEN-<PO>, our parser will attach the PO to the payment record automatically.

Next steps:
1) Lumen sends first invoice with description containing LUMEN-<PO#>.
2) We schedule first payment for Redwood's next AP run (cutoff is 5pm PT on 09/24).
3) If any remittance confirmation is required on your side, we'll email payremit@lumenlabs.com with the payment trace.

Attaching micro-deposit-stub.pdf for your records.

Jordan Blake
Senior Accounting Manager — Payments
Redwood Inference
